questions.question: Which state government in India signed an MoU with Iceland for geothermal energy development in January 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Uttarakhand government signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Iceland’s Verkis Consulting Engineers for the exploration and development of geothermal energy in the state.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uttarakhand identified 40 geothermal sites across the state as part of its initiative to achieve carbon neutrality by 2070.**
 
• The Icelandic government will cover the costs for the feasibility study of geothermal energy in Uttarakhand.
 
• The Geological Survey of India and Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology conducted assessments identifying geothermal potential in the state.
 
• The MoU signing took place in the presence of Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami and Iceland’s Ambassador to India, Dr. Benedikt Hoskuldsson.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Geothermal Energy__

 __
 
• Renewable energy derived from the heat stored beneath the Earth's surface.
 
• Used for electricity generation, direct heating, and geothermal heat pumps for residential and commercial purposes.
 
 
 
• Verkis Consulting Engineers__
 __
 
• An Icelandic firm with global expertise in geothermal energy exploration and development.
 
• Will play a key role in implementing geothermal projects in Uttarakhand.
 
 
 
• India’s Renewable Energy Goals__
 
 
• Committed to achieving carbon neutrality by 2070.
 
• Encouraging innovative energy solutions like geothermal energy to support sustainable development.

questions.question: Which is the first northeastern state to partner with Bhashini for multilingual e-governance?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Tripura**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Tripura became the first North Eastern and Eastern Indian state** to sign an **MoU with Bhashini** for **multilingual governance** under the **Digital India initiative**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The agreement was signed with **Digital India Bhashini Division (DIBD), MeitY**, under the guidance of **CM Prof. Dr. Manik Saha**, aiming to **increase the use of regional languages in governance**.
 
• The **MoU signing took place at Pragna Bhavan, Agartala**, during the **‘Bhashini Rajyam’ State Level Workshop**, inaugurated by **Tripura’s IT Minister Pranajit Singha Roy**.
 
• **Bhashini enables AI-driven real-time translation**, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and **voice-to-voice translation** across **22 Indian languages**, bridging **digital and literacy divides**.
 
• The initiative **integrates with governance apps like CM Helpline, eVidhan, Kisan Sahayata, and e-Districts**, **enhancing multilingual communication** in Tripura’s **rural and tribal areas**.
 
• **Bhashini’s integration** will assist in **FIR translations, voice-based data entry for CCTNS, education accessibility, and improved digital governance**.
 
• Tripura is **the eighth state in India to adopt Bhashini**, joining **four other states** that conducted similar **workshops on digital inclusivity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **100 million+ monthly inferences**, highlighting Bhashini’s **growing AI language technology reach**.
 
• **50+ stakeholders onboarded**, including **NPCI, RBIH, MoRD, Lok Sabha, and Rajya Sabha**, ensuring **strong government and private sector collaboration**.
 
• **700,000+ mobile app downloads**, demonstrating **widespread adoption and accessibility**.
 
• **100+ use cases supported**, proving **Bhashini’s adaptability across industries and sectors**.
 
• **22+ languages supported**, promoting **linguistic inclusivity and digital participation**.
 
• **300+ AI-based models**, advancing **state-of-the-art language technology solutions**.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Chairman and Managing Director (CMD) of the Food Corporation of India (FCI)? (January 2025)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashutosh Agnihotri.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Ashutosh Agnihotri, Additional Secretary in the Home Ministry, has been appointed as CMD of FCI.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **FCI is a statutory body under the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food, and Public Distribution.**
 
• **Established in 1965 under the Food Corporation Act, 1964.**
 
• **FCI manages food procurement, storage, and distribution across India.**
 
• **Headquartered in New Delhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Food Corporation of India (FCI)__

 __
 
• Primary function: Ensure food security by managing procurement, storage, and distribution of food grains.
 
• Operates under the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food, and Public Distribution.
 
 
 
• Key Roles of CMD__
 
 
• Oversees FCI's operations, policies, and strategic decisions.
 
• Ensures smooth functioning of food procurement and distribution systems.

questions.question: India ranked 4th in the Global Firepower Index 2025. Which country topped the Global Firepower Index 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is ​**USA**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] __In News__**

__
 
• India has been ranked **4th** on the **Global Firepower Index 2025** with a score of **0.1184**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The **United States** is ranked **1st** with a score of **0.0744**, followed by **Russia** and **China**, both with a score of **0.0788**.
 
• **India's ranking** has remained the same as in the 2024 index, and the **top 4 countries** have not changed.
 
• **Bhutan** is ranked at the **bottom** of the index at **145th** position.
 
• **Pakistan's ranking** has dropped from **9th** in 2024 to **12th** in 2025.
 
• The **Global Firepower Index** evaluates **military power** based on **conventional capabilities**, not nuclear strength, covering over 60 parameters such as **manpower**, **natural resources**, **finance**, and **geography**.
 
• The ideal score is **0.0000**, indicating perfect military strength, which no country possesses.
 
• **India** was ranked **1st** globally in terms of **population reaching military age annually**.
 
• India was also ranked **2nd** in **population**, **available manpower**, and **vehicles**.
 
• However, India ranked poorly in areas like **oil consumption**, **natural gas consumption**, **coal consumption**, **external borders**, and **external debts**.
 
• India was ranked **145th** in the world for **helicopter carrier strength** and **mine warfare capability** in the sea.
 
• The **Global Firepower Index** is released annually by **Globalfirepower.com** since 2006, comparing **145 countries** based on their **war-making capabilities** across land, sea, and air.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The top **10 countries** in the **Global Firepower Index 2025** are:

 
 
• **United States** - 0.0744
 
• **Russia** - 0.0788
 
• **China** - 0.0788
 
• **India** - 0.1184
 
• **South Korea** - 0.1656
 
• **United Kingdom** - 0.1785
 
• **France** - 0.1878
 
• **Japan** - 0.1839
 
• **Turkey** - 0.1902
 
• **Italy** - 0.2164

questions.question: Which Indian organisation has bagged Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar for disaster preparedness in January 2025?

options.text: Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services

questions.solution:
The correct answer is the __**Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• INCOIS bags Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar for disaster preparedness. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS), Hyderabad, has been awarded the prestigious Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar for 2025 in the Institutional Category.
 
• Recognized for its exemplary contributions to disaster management, INCOIS has played a vital role in enhancing India’s disaster preparedness and response mechanisms.
 
• Instituted by the Government of India under the leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, the Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar is awarded annually to honor individuals and organizations making significant contributions in disaster management.
 
• Announced on January 23, Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose’s birth anniversary, the award carries a cash prize of ₹51 lakh and a certificate for institutions, and ₹5 lakh with a certificate for individuals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India has witnessed remarkable advancements in disaster management practices, significantly reducing casualties during natural calamities.
 
• The award process for 2025 began on July 1, 2024, with widespread publicity, drawing 297 nominations from across the country.
 
• Established in 1999 in Hyderabad, Telangana, INCOIS is a cornerstone of India’s ocean-related disaster management strategies.
 
• It operates the Indian Tsunami Early Warning Centre (ITEWC), which can issue tsunami alerts within 10 minutes, serving both India and 28 Indian Ocean countries.
 
• UNESCO has recognized it as a leading Tsunami Service Provider globally.

62

questions.question: Which country is hosting the 1st International Pashmina Festival to promote "Chyangra Pashmina"?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Nepal**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **First-ever International Pashmina Festival** was held in **Kathmandu**, organized by the **Nepal Pashmina Industries Association** and the **Confederation of Nepalese Industries**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The event highlighted the unique **Chyangra Pashmina**, a delicate, lightweight, and warm natural fiber obtained from the undercoat of **Pashmina goats**.
 
• Nepal is a leading producer of **authentic Pashmina**, often branded as **Chyangra Pashmina**, which is **government-certified** for its quality and originality.
 
• The production process involves **hand-combing** the wool from Pashmina goats during their natural shedding season, followed by **hand-spinning** into fine threads and weaving on **traditional handlooms**.
 
• The festival featured **over 150 stalls**, with more than **40 stalls showcasing pure Nepali Pashmina**, running until **January 25**.
 
• **Minister for Industry, Commerce, and Supplies** Damodar Bhandari emphasized that Nepali Pashmina has made a name for itself internationally, competing with **China** and **Mongolia**, and is in demand in countries like **America**, **Japan**, and **Europe**.
 
• Challenges highlighted included ensuring the supply of **raw materials** to meet market demands and improving **policies** to support the industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chandra Dhakal**, President of the **Federation of Nepalese Chambers of Commerce and Industry**, called for greater **collaboration** between the government and the private sector to enhance the market for Nepali products both domestically and abroad.
 
• In **India**, Pashmina products are primarily created in **Ladakh**, **Jammu**, and **Kashmir**, with machine-woven versions produced in **Amritsar**, gaining worldwide popularity for their **softness**, **warmth**, and **intricate designs**.

questions.question: What is the theme of National Girl Child Day 2025?

options.text: Empowering Girls for a Bright Future
Educate and Empower the Girl Child

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Empowering Girls for a Bright Future.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **National Girl Child Day 2025 is observed on January 24 to raise awareness about the rights, education, health, and safety of girls.**
 
• **The theme for 2025 is “Empowering Girls for a Bright Future.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The theme emphasizes providing equal opportunities to girls to lead and shape their future.**
 
• National Girl Child Day was first observed in 2008 by the Ministry of Women and Child Development.
 
• It aims to address critical issues like child marriage, female foeticide, and gender inequality.
 
• The day also marks the anniversary of the Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao scheme launched on January 22, 2015.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao Scheme**__

 __
 
• Launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in 2015.
 
• Aims to combat female foeticide, gender discrimination, and promote education for girls.
 
 
 
• **National Girl Child Day**__
 
 
• Established to raise awareness about the challenges faced by girls and ensure their development through education, health, and nutrition.

questions.question: Who is the author of the autobiography On That Note: Memories of a Life in Music?

The correct answer is __**Sanjay Subrahmanyan**__

__

questions.question: The dockyard was found in which of the following sites of Indus valley civilization?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Lothal.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In Lothal Dockyard was found.
 
• **List of Important sites with their features:**

 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
**Harappa (Pakistan) **

 
Located on the bank of the** Ravi river.**

 Discovered by Daya Ram Sahini in 1921.

 
 
 
 
• Ist discovered site
 
• 2 rows of 6 granaries
 
• Sandstone statues of Human anatomy
 
• Bullock carts
 
• Coffin burials
 
 
 
 

 **Mohenjodaro** **(Pakistan) **Located on the bank of the **Indus river.**

 Discovered in Larkana District Of Sind by R. D Banerjee in 1922.

 Mohenjodaro means "Mount of the dead”.

 Also called an oasis of Sindh.
 
 
 
• Great Bath (Largest Brick Work)
 
• Great Granary (Largest Building)
 
• Impressive drainage system
 
• The bronze image of a dancing girl
 
• Image of steatite bearded man
 
• Piece of woven cotton
 
• Seal of Pashupati
 
• Skeletons on stairs of well
 
 
 
 

 **Chanhudaro (Pakistan) Located on the bank of the **Indus river.

 Discovered by NG Majumdar.
 
 
 
• Lancashire of India
 
• The only city without a citadel
 
• Bangles Factory
 
• Beads Factory
 
 
 
 

 
 
**Dholavira (Gujarat) **

 
Located on the bank of **Luni river.**

 In Rann of Kutch.

 Discovered by JP Joshi.

 
 
 
 
• Exclusive water management.
 
 
 
 

 
 
**Banawali (Fatehabad) **

 
Located on the bank of the **Ghaggar river**

 Discovered by RS Bisht.

 
 
 
 

 
 
• Beads
 
• Barley
 
 
 
 

 **Rakhigarhi** **(Hissar) **
 
Located on the bank of the Ghaggar river.

 Discovered By Vasant Shinde.
 
 
 

 
 
• Biggest site of Indus valley civilization
 
 
 
 

 **Sutkagendor** **(Pakistan)**

 Baluchistan on Dast river.
 
 
 
• Between Harappa and Babylon
 
 
 
 

 
 
**Lothal (Gujarat)**

 
Located on the bank of the **Bhogwa river.**

 
 
 
 
• It has an** artificial Brick dockyard.**
 
• It has evidence of the earliest cultivation of Rice.
 
• It served as a seaport for Indus Valley People.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indus Valley Civilization was spread from present-day **North-East Afghanistan to Pakistan and North-West India**.
 
• The civilization flourished in the river basins of the **Ghaggar-Hakra river and the Indus**.
 
• Indus valley civilization is one of the **four oldest civilizations** in the world.
 
• It is also known as Harappan Civilization and is well-known for its organized planning based on the grid system.

**Important facts to be remembered.**

 
• Social features:-

 
 
• Indus valley civilization is the first urbanization in India.
 
• It has a well-planned **drainage system, grid pattern, and town planning.**
 
• They have possessed equality in society.
 
 

 
• Religious Facts:-

 
 
• Matridevi or Shakti is the Mother goddess.
 
• Yoni worship and Nature worship existed.
 
• They worshipped trees like Peepal.
 
• They also worshipped Fire worship called Havan Kund.
 
• Pashupati Mahadeva is known as the lord of Animals.
 
• The people of the Indus Valley Civilization worshipped Animal worship like unicorns and ox.
 
 
 
• Economic facts:-
 
 
• Indus valley civilization is based on agriculture.
 
• Trade and commerce flourished in this period.
 
• A dockyard has been found at Lothal.
 
• There were export and import.
 
• Production of cotton was there.
 
• At Lothal, weights and measures of truth existed in Harappan culture was seen.
 
• The weights and were usually cubical in shape and were made of limestone, steatite, etc
